workflows.name: implement
workflows.description: Plan a goal, do the work, and review it, as pull requests

steps.text:
Plan the work for this goal: {args.goal}
Split it into small tasks in {run}, each written for a reader with no context: what to build, which files it owns, what's out of scope, and the command that proves it's done.
No two tasks may change the same files at once; make one wait for the other with --needs.
Complete this task with the list of task IDs you made.

Do the work the plan task made in {run}, for this goal: {args.goal}
Take the tasks it queued that are ready, one at a time, and complete each with what you changed.

Review what the work task changed for this goal: {args.goal}
Read the pull requests it opened, run the tests, and complete this task with what you found, or fail it with what must change.

workflows.name: review
workflows.description: Review one thread's change and say what you found

steps.text: Review the change discussed in thread #{thread} of {channel}. Read it with mu read {thread}, check the work, and complete this task with what you found.
